messages.subject: Facet grid labels
parts:
Hi,

facet_grid doesn't add labels automatically. For example, I want 'drv'
be added at the top and 'cyl' be added at the right. Since the labels
"displ" and "hwy" are added automatically. I'd think that it is
reasonable to expect the labels "drv" and "cyl" also be added
automatically. Would anybody let me know how add such labels?

qplot(displ, hwy, data=mpg) + facet_grid(drv ~ cyl)


--
Regards,
Peng

On 10-10-27 10:58 AM, Peng Yu wrote:
> Hi,
>
> facet_grid doesn't add labels automatically. For example, I want 'drv'
> be added at the top and 'cyl' be added at the right. Since the labels
> "displ" and "hwy" are added automatically. I'd think that it is
> reasonable to expect the labels "drv" and "cyl" also be added
> automatically. Would anybody let me know how add such labels?
>
> qplot(displ, hwy, data=mpg) + facet_grid(drv ~ cyl)
>
>

One possibility, from
<http://stackoverflow.com/questions/2403466/greek-letters-in-ggplot-strip-text>,
is:

label_parseall <- function(variable, value) {
plyr::llply(value, function(x) parse(text = paste(variable,
x, sep = "==")))

cyl,labeller=label_parseall)

[ label_parseall() is actually overkill for this problem, it's
intended for when there is Greek/math annotation in the labels]

I can see that one might want the labels to be generated a single
time, in the outer margin, but how would one then distinguish them from
the axis labels? I suppose if they were in 'outer gray strips' ...

Ben Bolker
